business_problem: Koerber support was heavily dependent on email and phone, which left the organization reactive, increased case backlog, and made service quality harder to scale.
solution_summary: Koerber support was heavily dependent on email and phone, which left the organization reactive, increased case backlog, and made service quality harder to scale. Koerber Supply Chain implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around Customer Service Management Pro, Field Service Management, Virtual Agent, and CMDB. Key components included Customer Service Management Pro adds advanced automation for customer support; Field Service Management links field work to support workflows; Virtual Agent handles conversational self-service; CMDB stores service and asset context. Requests enter through Virtual Agent, and uses context from CMDB before Customer Service Management Pro and Field Service Management routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running customer support and case management on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
